name: Akiiro Onmyouji
source:
Two boys enter a school where strange incidents occur one after another. The new transfer student turns out to be exterminator of spirits and youkai. Student council, occult research and home economics clubs all require help. The slapstick school life begins around the two opposite personality protagonists.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
